requirements.title: the reviewed commit, checked out clean and detached
requirements.why: a compaction is run BY code. If the deployed tree is not exactly the reviewed commit, the review adjudicated something else.

requirements.title: a live segmented manifest the store would accept
requirements.why: the manifest is the authority for what is served. Without one there is no segmented base to compact into, and `SegmentedCubeStore` has nothing to open.

requirements.reason: cannot check blocks: no manifest root at '/home/odbadmin/Data/ghrsst/p5_blocks'
requirements.title: every referenced block present and passing the strict contract
requirements.why: a manifest referencing a block that is absent or malformed publishes a view nobody can read; the failure surfaces at request time, on the live service.

requirements.title: an initialized P5 WAL, an anchor outside the domain, and a declared rollback domain
requirements.why: the WAL is how a half-finished compaction is recognised as half-finished. An anchor inside the domain it witnesses is lost with it, and an undeclared domain means no one has said what a rollback would restore.

requirements.title: canonical compaction and ingest lock paths, in the declared order
requirements.why: compaction and ingest both mutate the served view. Two writers with no shared lock path are not excluded from each other at all.

requirements.reason: proving this needs a service serving the manifest. On VM24 that is either a live switchover or a second isolated service -- both are production changes and neither is authorized by a read-only preflight.
requirements.title: the API serves the segmented base with values matching the current base
requirements.why: routing and value parity can only be shown by a service actually serving the manifest -- which means switching the live deployment, or standing up an isolated second one.

requirements.reason: free 1260.7 GiB against a 403.3 GiB minimum (run 20260821T130320Z)
requirements.title: free space above the minimum, from a fresh measurement
requirements.why: a block build needs the space before it starts. A figure with no run behind it is a number in a file.

requirements.reason: no suite was named as proving the refusal, rollback and partial-staging behaviour for this target
requirements.title: fail-closed refusal, rollback and partial-staging behaviour
